{c_label}Faith Cost:{/c_label} {c_resource}{Resource Cost}{/c_resource}
{c_label}Cooldown:{/c_label} {c_resource}{Cooldown Time}{/c_resource} seconds
{c_label}Passive:{/c} Spending Faith emanates power from you, granting you and your allies {c_number}[{SF_6}*100|1%+|]{/c} Attack Speed and {c_number}[{SF_4}*100|1%+|]{/c} Critical Strike Chance for {c_number}{SF_10}{/c} seconds up to a maximum of {c_number}[{SF_8}]{/c} times.

{c_label}Active:{/c} {c_important}{u}Weaken{/u}{/c} all Nearby enemies for {c_number}{SF_1}{/c} seconds.
{c_number}[{SF_6}*100|1%+|]{/c} Attack Speed and {c_number}[{SF_4}*100|%+|]{/c} Critical Strike Chance per stack.
{c_important}Fanaticism Aura's{/c} passive also grants you and your allies {c_number}[SF_15*100|%|]{/c} Maximum Resource.

{c_important}Fanaticism Aura{/c} Passive increases Critical Strike Damage by {c_number}[{SF_9} * 100|%x|]{/c} for you and your allies.

Critical Strikes trigger {c_important}Fanaticism's{/c} Passive.

{c_important}Fanaticism Aura's{/c} active instead makes Nearby enemies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{SF_14}{/c} seconds. 

Damaging {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} enemies will also trigger {c_important}Fanaticism's{/c} Passive.

{c_important}{u}Weakened{/u}{/c} enemies who die within {c_important}Fanaticism Aura's{/c} radius Heal you for {c_number}[{SF_11} * 100|1%|]{/c} and {c_important}{u}Fortify{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[SF_16 * 100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,PlayerHealthMax() * {SF_16})]){/c}.
